title: trec output schema
description: Single-label question classification by expected ANSWER TYPE. Metric: accuracy.

label.description: The type of answer the question expects (not the question's topic).

labelDefinitions.Description: Answer is a definition, description, manner, or reason (what/why/how).
labelDefinitions.Entity: Answer is a thing — animal, color, product, substance, work, etc.
labelDefinitions.Expression: Answer is an abbreviation or its expansion (what does X stand for).
labelDefinitions.Human: Answer is a person, group, or organization (who).
labelDefinitions.Location: Answer is a place — city, country, geographic feature (where).
labelDefinitions.Number: Answer is a count, date, distance, money, or other numeric value.
